_provenance.notes: CU-155 refresh (2026-07-18). E_sky_thermal rebuilt: target-anchored emission temperature T(h_tgt + 200 m) with flux-diffusivity exponent D = 1.1 on the target->h_atm_top vertical column, fit to the real MODTRAN 6 up-looking H-runs (pre-fix the model evaluated T at 0.5*h_sensor, clamping the space column to 216.65 K: MWIR downwelling ~40x low). The eps=0.95 target's Kirchhoff-reflected sky term rises accordingly: signal_e +1.48% (936848 -> 950709 e-), snr +0.74% (967.85 -> 974.99). | CU-007 refresh (2026-04-27). Pre-CU-007 chain routed MWIR ε+T scenes to T1Thermal (pure-emit). Post-CU-007 routes them to T3Mixed (emit + Kirchhoff-reflected sky); ε=0.95 ⇒ ρ=0.05 lifts signal_e by ~5.5% (750264 → 791901 e-) and snr by 866 → 890 (signal-shot-limited regime). Hot-target opt-out lives at source.target.is_hot_target. Pre-CU-007 history: Stage 4 Option C (2026-04-19) dropped the legacy scalar L_background term (Decision #13/#15), lifting snr from 666.21 to 866.11.
